message: I was cooking up a storm last weekend, phone propped up on the counter, streaming my favorite recipe video. Just as the smoke alarm started to beep (oops!), my phone decided it was the perfect moment to die. Talk about a wake-up call! It reminded me how important it is to have a good escape plan and know where those smoke alarms are. Technology’s great, but sometimes it's nice to rely on good old-fashioned safety measures. Have you checked your smoke alarms lately? 🔥
